validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed, not a GEM-only entity. Six independent-origin sources consistently describe the same project by its official title across 2021-2025: (1) a federal government decree (Rasporyazhenie Pravitelstva RF No. 816-r, Territorial Planning Scheme Appendix 4.1, via sudact.ru) lists it as item 112, capacity '3,2 млрд. куб. метров' spanning Partizansky + Shkotovsky districts + Nakhodka Urban Okrug; (2) Primorsky Krai regional government press release (primorsky.ru, Oct 2021, via Wayback) on the 2021-2025 gasification program, target 'до конца 2022 года', 98 km; (3)+(4) two separate NZMU (Nakhodka mineral fertilizer plant) company press releases (nzmu.ru) -- one on the trunk branch itself (98 km, contractor Gazstroyprom, quoting Primorsky minister Andrey Leontiev), one on NZMU's own downstream tie-in describing the trunk line as only 38% welded as of March 2022; (5) a live June-2024 rostender.info tender (#76781769) for pile-foundation electric-supply work at km-post 429/tower 4 of the exact named project, Stage I; (6) Gazstroyprom's own internal 2025 procurement registry (gsprom.ru XLSX, archived as archive.org/details/gsprom_tenders_2025-05) naming the identical project code '905-25/601X, 225/29' with May-Aug 2025 work items (in-line-inspection anomaly remediation, tie-in to an operating pipeline, fire-safety/reclamation). CLASSIFICATION: no concern -- 'газопровод-отвод' (branch/lateral to a GRS) as GEM's PipelineType=transmission is standard GEM convention; Fuel=Gas is unanimous across all six sources. DUPLICATE: checked against the 32-pipeline roster -- no match/relabel risk found. Distinguished from two textually-adjacent but genuinely different lines found in the same federal decree/local coverage: (a) item 111 in the same decree, 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «ВНХК»' (2.3 bcm/y, different endpoint) -- NOT on the 32-row roster, flagged as a possible future Discovery lead, not a duplicate of P4111; (b) a separate short downstream spur (GRS Vrangel -> NZMU plant, 600mm, 3.5km, Glavgosexpertiza-approved) mentioned in the second nzmu.ru article -- also not P4111 and not part of its own 98km length figure.
